description:
Register a webhook endpoint

Registers an HTTPS endpoint and subscribes it to the named events. The response contains a `secret`, and this is the only time it is ever returned: store it before you do anything else, because no endpoint anywhere in this API will show it to you again, and losing it means deleting the endpoint and registering a new one. The secret keys the HMAC-SHA256 signature sent with every delivery in the `X-EchoCall-Signature` header, which is how you prove a payload really came from us. Every name in `events` must be a name from GET /webhooks/events, or the literal `*` for all of them; an unknown name is rejected with 400 rather than silently never firing. The target URL is resolved and refused with 400 if it points at a private or internal address.

body.description: The destination URL, which must be publicly resolvable, and at least one event name to subscribe to.

name: create_webhook
